metadata.description:
While Vermont has some of the finest golf courses in Northeast, none can match the beauty and design of Green Mountain National Golf Course. With our exceptional layout, and dedication to service, we offer a great experience for golfers of all ability levels.
Located in the heart of Central Vermont, just minutes away from the Killington Resort, there are many exceptional lodging choices available within minutes of the course and great activities for you and your family to enjoy during your visit. Green Mountain National is also perfect for your next outing or tournament. We specialize in golf instruction as well as a activities designed specifically for women golfers. Take a moment to explore our website and see what Green Mountain National Golf Course has to offer. We look forward to seeing you on the First Tee!

Nestled in the Deerfield Valley of Southern Vermont, Haystack Golf Club will challenge your golfing skills while providing views of the spectacular Green Mountains. This Desmond Muirhead designed course is open to the public and within easy driving distance of Boston, Hartford and New York City. Reservations can be made for individuals or groups of all sizes.

metadata.description: It opened to play in 1896 on a nine hole layout designed by George Low. It was expanded to eighteen in 1928 under the guiding hand of Wayne Stiles. The course has been "growing in" ever since. Relatively few changes have been made to the layout. They haven't been necessary. Few clubs in the entire state receive higher all-around marks from the golfing public than does Rutland.
